research_questions_as_in_source.RQ2: What is the effect of applying Secure Aggregation to federated model updates on the detection performance and system overhead of the federated anomaly-detection system?

test_exposure_treatment.if_prior_test_driven_selection_is_later_: Disclose the specific use and label affected results exploratory. Do not silently reshuffle or rename a test split as unseen.

preprocessing.hour_feature: fractional hour including minute, second and fractional second
preprocessing.relative_time: log1p(nonnegative elapsed seconds in UTC); first previous-gap=0
preprocessing.scaler_fit: all original routine training events only; identical in both distributions and A/B/C
preprocessing.summary_transfer: training count, mean and M2 combined; plaintext summaries outside SecAgg protection claim
preprocessing.unknown_missing_loss_policy: map inputs according to approved schema; exclude unknown/missing or training-unseen categorical targets from CE; renormalise categorical mean over valid fields; if none, average binary and temporal groups only; report coverage

model.decoder_initial_h_c: separate linear projections without extra activation
model.loss: mean of mean categorical CE, binary BCEWithLogits and temporal SmoothL1; then mean across valid events/session; mean across sessions/batch
model.initialisation: PyTorch module defaults, explicit stable construction order; LSTM U(-1/sqrt(64),1/sqrt(64)); Linear U(-1/sqrt(fan_in),1/sqrt(fan_in)); no custom forget-gate bias
model.source: S10 architecture + S14 observed input dimension/parameter count

training_inherited_candidate.initial_state: one checkpoint per seed reused A/B/C
training_inherited_candidate.initialisation_algorithm: module defaults in fixed constructor order; save one state per seed/schema; reuse A/B/C
training_inherited_candidate.optimizer_state_between_rounds: reset before each client fit in B/C; reset before each pooled outer epoch in A; retain within each epoch
training_inherited_candidate.tensor_order: ordered state_dict keys, checked on every client
training_inherited_candidate.client_num_examples: number of scheduled complete sessions consumed in this local epoch, including replacement draws; never event count
training_inherited_candidate.source: Retained from S10 and observed S14/S16; adopted under delegation, main 30-round/epoch execution not performed.

sampling_inherited_candidate.reference: seeded permutation, no replacement, N_k draws
sampling_inherited_candidate.noniid: N_k draws with replacement; dominant group mass 0.60; remainder 0.40
sampling_inherited_candidate.mapping_status: new controlled experimental choice, not a claim of medically validated hospital profiles
sampling_inherited_candidate.session_department: modal recorded event department; lexical tie break
sampling_inherited_candidate.within_group: uniform across sessions; residual department probabilities follow local session counts
sampling_inherited_candidate.seed_derivation: first 8 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, modulo 2**32 of seed|condition|client|outer_epoch
sampling_inherited_candidate.centralised_pool: union of the exact client draws, then deterministic global batch order
sampling_inherited_candidate.JSD: mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence, log base 2, not square-root distance
sampling_inherited_candidate.observed_acceptance: both criteria on five-round pooled draw distributions; each dominant mass within 0.05 of 0.60
sampling_inherited_candidate.failure: stop and document, not search mappings for better test scores

secagg_observed_candidate.transmitted_object: full post-local-training model parameters, not gradients
secagg_observed_candidate.scope_approval_evidence: Researcher explicitly reported supervisor approval in conversation; not a cryptographic assurance certificate.
secagg_observed_candidate.threat_model_candidate: Honest-but-curious aggregation service following the prescribed protocol; honest non-colluding clients; trusted operating system/endpoints; no hostile network adversary; logical application-boundary claims only.

calibration_rule_inherited.fit_partition: routine validation only; full validation for final calibration
calibration_rule_inherited.degenerate_policy: record flag; report raw scores as well; do not claim nominal FPR guarantee
calibration_rule_inherited.checkpoint: minimum session-count-weighted routine validation loss; earliest epoch/round if difference <=1e-12
calibration_rule_inherited.score_output: raw and calibrated scores retained; same validation recipe A/B/C; no fit on tests

evaluation_inherited.primary: session-level Average Precision (AP), threat positive, sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score
evaluation_inherited.statistical_recipe_in_sources: Historical proposal only: hierarchical bootstrap. Superseded prospectively by the adopted seed-level plan in review/Evaluation_and_Analysis_Plan.md.

observed_environment.reporting_note: WSL memory visible to workload differs from physical Windows RAM; record both without substituting one for the other.

main_run_matrix.execution_order: config/main_run_order.csv; deterministic cyclic A/B/C order by seed with alternating condition order; not randomised, not perfectly balanced

derived_compute_accounting.note: A: 170 pooled steps per epoch; B/C: 171 local steps summed across clients per round. Equal data exposures are not identical optimisation trajectories or equal effective global updates. Do not silently alter last batches to force step equality.

external_reference_resolution.source_ids: S01-S26 and R01-R10 refer to the unchanged EHR_FL_Freeze_Readiness_Review_v1_0.zip, pinned in the authority record. Only five evidence files are copied here.
external_reference_resolution.legacy_paths: Paths inherited from the source candidate that are not present here resolve inside that source archive, not on the user computer.

adopted_evaluation_details.calibration_unit: configuration x condition x seed x client, using that client full routine validation only
adopted_evaluation_details.threshold_application: raw score > per-client 0.99 routine-validation quantile; affine-equivalent calibrated threshold retained for audit
adopted_evaluation_details.undefined_metrics: Explicit NA and denominators, not silent perfect/zero replacements. Absent-class AP/AUROC omitted. F1=0 when positives are present but none detected; undefined precision recorded separately.
adopted_evaluation_details.subgroups: Only label-supported scenario/error summaries. No new anomaly mechanism, new RQ or threat-only AUROC. Report the legitimate comparison set for any subgroup ranking metric.

P1_tuning.checkpoint_and_calibration_rules: unchanged; see inherited recipe; do not promise detection improvement

P2_statistics.change_from_v1_0: Supersedes the unaccepted 2,000-replicate actor/campaign hierarchical bootstrap proposal with paired seed-level summaries. This narrows the uncertainty target; it does not certify session independence.
P2_statistics.data_resampling: none; no event, session, actor, campaign or client resampling
P2_statistics.estimand: Run-to-run algorithmic variability conditional on this fixed benchmark, splits, preprocessing, checkpoint rule and calibration recipe; not sampling variability across datasets or hospitals.
P2_statistics.global_AP_score: client-calibrated scores using the inherited validation-only affine recipe
P2_statistics.secondary_global_AP_score: raw scores; never selected because its final test result is better
P2_statistics.per_client_AP_score: raw scores; preserve matched clients and report the worst-client identity
P2_statistics.worst_client_contrast: min_k(AP_C_k)-min_k(AP_B_k), and analogously B-A; report matched per-client deltas too

confidence_interval.scope: primary global and worst-client mean AP contrasts only; other metrics descriptive
confidence_interval.method: two-sided Student-t interval for the mean of five paired differences
confidence_interval.label: Exploratory, model-based conditional interval; nominal coverage not established by these five runs.
confidence_interval.assumptions: Run differences treated as independent realisations of the training-randomness procedure and approximately normally distributed. Five preselected seeds cannot substantiate normality or broad coverage.
confidence_interval.if_missing_or_undefined: Report the available values, missing counts/reasons and descriptive summaries; suppress the nominal interval and mark the planned block incomplete.
confidence_interval.if_zero_sample_SD: Report zero observed variability; suppress a misleading degenerate interval rather than claiming certainty.

P2_statistics.hypothesis_testing: No confirmatory p-value, equivalence or non-inferiority test; no significance-based pass/fail.
P2_statistics.multiple_comparisons: Named planned contrasts only; no superiority claim from whether an exploratory interval excludes zero; all conditions and all seeds shown.
P2_statistics.statistical_software: Use the pinned environment. No dependency upgrade is authorised by use of documentation.

P3_measurement.primary_communication: application record-content bytes, both directions counted once at client boundary; server count is an audit not an extra copy
P3_measurement.time: instrumented fit path; evaluation/startup/end-to-end wall time separate; not pure cryptography
P3_measurement.inference: prepared-input forward pass plus session score, not raw-event-to-alert latency
P3_measurement.main_cost_summary: one run-level summary per seed and condition, then paired C-B differences and 100*(C-B)/B for positive denominators; show slow runs and startup separately
P3_measurement.pilot_scope: Prior three timing pairs concern small Reference workload, not main full-data costs.

P5_failure_policy.eligible_cause: documented transient infrastructure fault only; not a slow but completed result, unfavourable metric, numerical failure, code failure or security-guard failure
P5_failure_policy.retry_unit: entire matched A/B/C seed-condition block from fresh initialisation, no checkpoint resume; preserve the first attempt and log why the retry is primary
P5_failure_policy.selection: first complete fault-free block under the rule, never best performance or fastest time
P5_failure_policy.if_retry_fails: mark incomplete and report; no substitute seed
P5_failure_policy.code_or_security_failure: stop; diagnose, version and revalidate affected work before resuming; no ad hoc bypass
